question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a yellow ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a brown ball, Fred has a red ball, and Gertrude has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Finally, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) yellow ball
(B) pink ball
(C) gold ball
(D) white ball
(E) brown ball
(F) red ball
(G) grey ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (yellow, pink, gold, white, brown, red, grey)
1. Bob and Eve swap: (yellow, brown, gold, white, pink, red, grey)
2. Eve and Fred swap: (yellow, brown, gold, white, red, pink, grey)
3. Fred and Alice swap: (pink, brown, gold, white, red, yellow, grey)
4. Alice and Claire swap: (gold, brown, pink, white, red, yellow, grey)
5. Bob and Eve swap: (gold, red, pink, white, brown, yellow, grey)
6. Dave and Bob swap: (gold, white, pink, red, brown, yellow, grey)
7. Eve and Gertrude swap: (gold, white, pink, red, grey, yellow, brown)
Alice has the gold ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
